AccessibilityEnabledComment: When true, overrides certain values to make firestarting significantly easier.
TargetValueComment: How much progress is required to complete the firestarting minigame.
GainPerValidClickComment: Progress added for each valid alternating click (LMB/RMB alternation).
DecayTickIntervalMsComment: How often progress decays once decay has begun.
DecayPerTickComment: How much progress is removed each decay tick.
